module purpose: This module decodes a supported crypto operation request from ctrl_i, latches rs1_i/rs2_i and selector bits, sequences xperm, SHA, SM3, AES and SM4 subword transforms according to the EN_* generics, and drives the selected 32-bit result on res_o with valid_o derived from done.

use-case flows.value: decode a supported request and capture its operands and selector bits
xperm nibble/byte permutation result from rs1 and rs2
SHA transform result from rs1 and rs2
AES or SM4 subword/block-cipher result from a selected rs2 byte and the rs1 xor/rotation path
latched operands, selector state, done/state, result, AES mix state, and SM4 round state cleared when rstn_i is low

conceptual assets.reasoning: The request family is decoded into cmd from ctrl_i fields at lines 274-293, and cmd_valid is asserted at line 296 only when ctrl_i.alu_cp_alu is high and any cmd bit is set. cmd_valid then gates operand/selector capture at lines 312-317 and the start decision at lines 323-325 and 327-328. Integrity is established because a wrong accept/reject or family decode changes whether the module starts an operation and whether it takes the immediate-done or busy path. Availability is established under those RTL-visible predicates. Although the FLOW GRAPH lists cmd and cmd_valid as not reached from a source, their own records and the RTL at lines 274-296 show the decode.

conceptual assets.concept: Latched operand words for the accepted request
conceptual assets.reasoning: When cmd_valid is high, rs1_i and rs2_i are copied into rs1 and rs2 at lines 313-314. The stored operands are then read by xperm at lines 383 and 389, by SHA at lines 413-425, by SM3 at line 441, and by the block-cipher result path at line 475. Integrity is established because corrupt captured operands make those computations incorrect. Availability is established because the registers hold the accepted operand values between capture and use.

When cmd_valid is high, ctrl_i.ir_funct3 and ctrl_i.ir_funct12 are copied into funct3 and funct12 at lines 315-316. funct3 selects xperm8 versus xperm4 at line 393; funct12 drives out_sel at line 372, SHA variant selection at lines 411-425, the SM3 branch at line 441, rs2 byte selection at line 456, AES mode at line 494, AES mix selection at line 525, and SM4 round variants at lines 560-565. Integrity is established because these stored selector bits determine which result is computed and returned. Availability is established because the registers retain them until the later stages read them.

state is reset to S_IDLE at line 309, examined in the case statement at line 320, moves from S_IDLE either to S_BUSY or back to S_IDLE at lines 323-328, moves from S_BUSY to S_DONE at line 333, and returns to S_IDLE from the done state at lines 336-337. Integrity is established because this state controls the implemented latency and completion sequencing of the request. Availability is established by the explicit RTL transitions under cmd_valid and cmd-class conditions.

conceptual assets.concept: Completion indication for the current request
conceptual assets.reasoning: done is cleared at line 319, asserted for the immediate path at line 327 or for the later completion path at line 336, copied to valid_o at line 343, and used to gate the result write at line 354. Integrity is established because external completion reporting and result update both depend on done being correct. Availability is established on the RTL-visible state paths that assign done.

In EN_ZBKX builds, xperm8_res and xperm4_res are derived from the latched operands at lines 383 and 389, and xperm_res selects between them with funct3(2) at line 393. res_o copies xperm_res on the out_sel="100" branch at lines 355-357 when done is asserted. Integrity is established because this is the returned permutation value. Availability is conditional on EN_ZBKX; when that generic is false, lines 397-401 force the path to zero.

In EN_ZKNH builds, sha_res is selected by funct12 and computed from rs1 or from rs1 and rs2 across lines 411-425. On the default result branch, and when the SM3-specific test at line 361 is false, res_o copies sha_res at lines 360-365. Integrity is established because this is the returned SHA transform value. Availability is conditional on EN_ZKNH; when that generic is false, line 433 forces zero.

In EN_ZKSH builds, sm3_res is computed from rs1 at line 441, with funct12(0) selecting which rotate pattern is used. res_o copies sm3_res on the branch at lines 361-362. Integrity is established because this is the returned SM3 transform value. Availability is conditional on EN_ZKSH; when that generic is false, line 446 forces zero.

When EN_ZKNE or EN_ZKND is enabled, aes.dec is derived from funct12 and the AES-enable generics at line 494, aes.so registers the table lookup aes_sbox_c(aes.dec & rs2_sel) at lines 499-500, aes.mix1 registers the decrypt or encrypt mix values from aes.so at lines 510-519, and aes.mix2 selects between aes.mix1 and zero-extended aes.so at line 525 for the later block-cipher path at lines 463-475. Integrity is established because the returned block-cipher result depends on these AES-internal decision and data values. Availability is established for the enabled build and the clocked lookup/mix stages; when both AES generics are false, lines 531-534 force zeros.

When EN_ZKSED is enabled, sm4.so1 registers sm4_sbox_c(rs2_sel) at lines 546-547, sm4.so2 zero-extends it at line 552, and sm4.rnd registers one of the two linear transforms selected by funct12(6) at lines 560-565. The later block-cipher path reads sm4.rnd at lines 463-475. Integrity is established because the returned block-cipher result depends on these SM4-internal values. Availability is established for the enabled build and the clocked lookup/round stage; when EN_ZKSED is false, lines 574-576 force zeros.

In builds with EN_ZKNE or EN_ZKND or EN_ZKSED, funct12 selects the rs2 byte at lines 456-460, rol_in chooses AES.mix2 or sm4.rnd at lines 463-465, rol_res rotates that word at lines 468-472, and blk_res is formed as rs1 xor rol_res at line 475. res_o copies blk_res on the out_sel 101/110 branch at lines 355 and 358-359 when done is asserted. Integrity is established because this is the returned AES/SM4 subword result. Availability is conditional on those enabled builds; when all three generics are false, lines 481-484 force zero.
